name: Job name
processorHelp: Use the exact name registered by the business application's processor.
postHelp: Run the processor's Post stage after sharded work ends. Only available for sharded Jobs.
cronHelp: Six fields including seconds, evaluated in the scheduler's time zone. Preview upcoming times before saving.
paramsHelp: Text passed to the processor. Its format is defined by the business application.
blockDiscard: Skip while an Instance is active
retryHelp: Additional Task attempts after the first attempt; 0 disables retries.
secondsHelp: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying a Task.
timeoutHelp: The execution deadline for an Instance, including all of its stages.
createHelp: New Jobs are disabled. Enable the Job after checking its configuration, or run it manually.
editHelp: Only disabled Jobs can be edited. Changes apply to future Instances.
disableBeforeEdit: Disable this Job before editing it.
disableBeforeDelete: Disable this Job before deleting it.
discard: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
disableConfirm: Disable scheduled execution for {name}? Existing Instances are not stopped.
deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Jobs with active Instances cannot be deleted. Existing execution records are retained. This cannot be undone.
manualHelp: Creates one execution Instance. Disabled Jobs can also run manually. The Job's overlap policy still applies.
overridePlaceholder: Enter parameters, or leave empty to override with empty text
retryHelpText: The previous response was not confirmed. Retry with the same request ID and parameters to avoid creating another Instance. Closing and reopening this dialog on this page keeps the same request; reloading the page does not. Check execution history if unsure.
newRequestWarning: The previous request may already have created an Instance. A new request can create another execution. Check execution history before continuing.
